crime_near.evening_share_method: share of last-24-month complaints with a recorded start time (cmplnt_fr_tm) whose start hour is 19 to 23. For thefts found later, the start time is the beginning of the window in which it could have happened.

provenance.source: NYPD Complaint Data Historic (qgea-i56i) and Current Year To Date (5uac-w243), NYC Open Data
provenance.method: count of complaints whose published latitude/longitude is within 250 m (planar distance) of the point

caveats: NYPD publishes the midpoint of the street segment or the nearest intersection, not the exact address, so a count at a small radius is approximate.
Complaints with no coordinates are left out: 2023: 0 of 107732, 2024: 1 of 100500, 2025: 0 of 98053, 2026: 1 of 66749 rows in the slice.
Counts are not divided by population: busy commercial streets and transit hubs collect more complaints.

vs_baseline.method: Regular 300 m grid over the NYPD precinct polygons; a grid point counts as residential when 2020 Census blocks with their internal point within 250 m hold at least 500 residents; the incidents_near counts (radius 250 m) are computed at every such point and summarised by median, 80th and 90th percentile.

electric.method: Con Edison average price 36.74 cents/kWh (EIA-861 2025, revenue / sales, residential, bundled service (Part A)) x 259 kWh/month (3112 kWh/year): RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast (Middle Atlantic + New England) apartments in 5+ unit buildings whose main heat is not electric, 1 bedroom, weighted mean, n=165. Cross-check: published Table CE2.2 gives 4,650 kWh/year for all such apartments, electric heat included. Territory: point-in-polygon on HIFLD/ORNL Electric Retail Service Territories (2022 vintage), with documented overrides.

if_heat_is_electric_add.note: RECS 2020 space-heating kWh in electrically heated Northeast apartments (5+ units), n=119; applies only if the tenant pays for electric heat. Not added to the amount.

cooking_only.method: Con Edison (gas), SC 1 Residential and Religious Firm Sales Service: $33.23/month covers the first 3 therms (or Ccf) or less; gas supply for those therms, surcharges and taxes are extra (a few dollars) (rates effective 2026-01-01, sheet for 2026-11); assumed cooking use 1.6 therms/month (RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings with gas cooking, n=108). Taxes not included.

cooking_plus_heat.method: cooking-only figure ($33) + NY average residential gas price $1.704/therm (EIA 2025 annual, $17.58/Mcf at 1032 Btu per cubic foot) x 11.7 therms/month of space heating (annual use / 12; RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings heated with gas, n=124). An annual average: winter bills are several times higher and summer bills lower. Water heating is not included.

if_gas_water_heater_add.note: only if the unit has its own gas water heater; RECS 2020, n=128. Not added to the amount.

notes: gas utility from point-in-polygon on the HIFLD Natural Gas Service Territories layer (2016-17 vintage)
whether heat is included is unknown: the cooking-only figure is shown; heat may be extra (see cooking_plus_heat)

alternatives.note: before the $10 Auto Pay and paper-free discount

total.method: sum of the electric, gas and internet amounts above (lines that are not_found count as 0)

electric.method: Con Edison average price 36.74 cents/kWh (EIA-861 2025, revenue / sales, residential, bundled service (Part A)) x 219 kWh/month (2631 kWh/year): RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast (Middle Atlantic + New England) apartments in 5+ unit buildings whose main heat is not electric, studio, weighted mean, n=18; small sample. Cross-check: published Table CE2.2 gives 4,650 kWh/year for all such apartments, electric heat included. Territory: point-in-polygon on HIFLD/ORNL Electric Retail Service Territories (2022 vintage), with documented overrides.

if_heat_is_electric_add.note: RECS 2020 space-heating kWh in electrically heated Northeast apartments (5+ units), n=18; applies only if the tenant pays for electric heat. Not added to the amount.

cooking_only.method: Con Edison (gas), SC 1 Residential and Religious Firm Sales Service: $33.23/month covers the first 3 therms (or Ccf) or less; gas supply for those therms, surcharges and taxes are extra (a few dollars) (rates effective 2026-01-01, sheet for 2026-11); assumed cooking use 1.4 therms/month (RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings with gas cooking, n=13). Taxes not included.

cooking_plus_heat.method: cooking-only figure ($33) + NY average residential gas price $1.704/therm (EIA 2025 annual, $17.58/Mcf at 1032 Btu per cubic foot) x 8.3 therms/month of space heating (annual use / 12; RECS 2020 microdata, Northeast apartments in 5+ unit buildings heated with gas, n=14). An annual average: winter bills are several times higher and summer bills lower. Water heating is not included.

if_gas_water_heater_add.note: only if the unit has its own gas water heater; RECS 2020, n=17. Not added to the amount.
